Each image comes with a description of the camera position from which it was taken.
Please use this information to help answer the following question.



Scenario 1:

Image 1 (ego_left): From the robot's left arm, a wrist camera records this view of the manipulation.


Image 2 (fix_center): This perspective shows the manipulation task from the center of the camera setup.
